privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title is 'Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) - Student Well-Being Study'. Reverse scoring applies ONLY to PSS04, PSS05, PSS07, and PSS08 (Never=4, Almost Never=3, Sometimes=2, Fairly Often=1, Very Often=0). Assessment rules must match these exact ranges and messages: 0-13 ('Low perceived stress'), 14-26 ('Moderate perceived stress'), and 27-40 ('High perceived stress'). The survey must be activated at the end.
